body.statement: Under independent and identically distributed sampling, positive probabilities for the finitely many assignment arms, and a finite second moment for the observed outcome, the within-assignment receipt and outcome cell means admit a joint asymptotically linear representation with influence coordinates \(\phi_{q,zt}\) and \(\phi_{r,zt}\), and their empirical plug-in covariance is consistent.  Fixed linear combinations therefore have influence coordinates \(\phi_{p,t}\) and \(\phi_{m,t}\).  The multivariate delta method applies to differentiable finite-dimensional transformations whose denominators are nonzero; each fixed nondegenerate linear moment \(\widehat m_t-u\widehat p_t\) has a standard-normal studentized limit, and a seven-dimensional transformation with positive-definite covariance has the usual chi-square Wald limit.
